verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਬਲੀ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਸਫਲ ਸਘਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਰਨ ਦੋਖੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਰੈ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: birakh balee milaap safal saghan chhaiaa baa(n)s tau baran dhokhee milai jarai jaar hai ||

en.bdb: Many fruit-bearing trees along with creepers climbing upon them become dense of shade. They provide comfort to all wayfarers. But Bamboo that rubs with each other becomes cause of its own destruction through fire and for others as well who are near it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਤਰਹਰਿ ਝੁਕਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਤਰੁ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਆਪਨੁ ਸੰਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal hui tarahar jhukat sakal tar baa(n)s tau baddaiee booddio aapan sa(n)maar hai ||

en.bdb: All other fruit-bearing trees bow down but a Bamboo tree sublimed in his own praise keep accumulating pride.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਰੀਤੋ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਬਾਜੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sakal banaasapatee sudh ridhai mon gahe baa(n)s tau reeto gaTheelo baaje dhaar maar hai ||

en.bdb: All fruit trees remain at peace at heart and are silent of disposition. They produce no sounds. But the tall Bamboo is hollow from inside and is knotted. It wails and produces noise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਹੀ ਅਛਤ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਜਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੮॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sameep hee achhat niraga(n)dh rahe gursikh dhokhee bajar praanee na udhaar hai ||308||

en.bdb: He who remains proud and hypocrite despite living in the close proximity of Sandalwood like True Guru, (remains fragrance-less) and does not acquire Guru's wisdom, such a person whoever wishes ill of Guru's disciples can never sail across the worldly ocean. (308)
